thread:
incident-bot: :bangbang: PAGER: warmup-load-flap in us-west-2 (route: /v1/generate). Symptoms: shard deserialization errors + JIT compile stalls -> OOMs -> container restarts. Affected model: redwood-ggml-xl. Paging @alice-oncall.

alice-oncall: Ack. Who's seeing the failures and are any production requests impacted?

bob-runtime: We're seeing three failure modes on multiple hosts (usw2-host-5, usw2-host-22, usw2-host-31): (a) `checkpoint footer truncated` during download, (b) `cudaLaunchKernel returned UNKNOWN ERROR` during first token, and (c) long-running kernel JITs that exceed our 20s cutoff and block other activities. Customer error rate for /v1/generate in region spiked to ~8% in the last 6m.

carol-sre: k8s shows `OOMKilled` on `runtime-warmup` sidecars then CrashLoopBackOff. Horizontal warmup autoscaler also started more replicas which created a stampede.

alice-oncall: Ok. Immediate mitigations: 1) pause warmup autoscaler 2) cordon offending nodes 3) enable model fallback routing to reduce customer impact. @frank-infra do the cordon and autoscaler pause.

frank-infra: done: cordoned usw2-host-31 and paused warmup HPA for us-west-2 via `kubectl patch hpa warmup-autoscaler -n inference -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":0}}'`. Also suspended scheduled pre-warm cron.

incident-bot: :information_source: Automated action: fallback routing flag applied -> /v1/generate will serve `redwood-ggml-small` in us-west-2 for 30m.

eva-product: Will degrading to small model break any contract? We should check function-calling customers.

david-support: Telemetry: two customers (C-900, C-921) opened errors; flagged to CE. Function-calling customers show degraded accuracy but still usable; CE approves temporary fallback. No security incidents.

grace-ml: From debug logs: kernel JIT time distribution on hosts with driver 470 shows long tail; median 42s for some kernels. Our 20s timeout was too aggressive and caused partial JIT state that leaves GPU memory fragmented. Also deserialization attempted to allocate one 24GB contiguous buffer on GPU which failed and led to fallback to CPU while JIT continued.

bob-runtime: Also found corrupted shards on mirror A (missing footer), mirror B had clean shards. Runtime currently blindly retries against same mirror; need checksum+mirror-failover.

alice-oncall: Proposed short-term plan: 1) keep fallback routing active 2) stop any new warmups in region for 20m 3) deploy runtime hotfix: checksum validation, mirror failover, limit concurrent shard-loads=2, compile_timeout=120s, and jittered backoff 4) run canary to verify. Agreed?

bob-runtime: Agreed. I'm prepping a hotfix branch. Will also add runtime guard to serialize JIT requests per GPU while warmup is running.

frank-infra: Preparing canary: will roll hotfix to us-west-2-canary node pool. Also collecting kube logs and freeing cached artifacts on nodes to avoid stale corruptions. Commands: `rm -rf /var/lib/artifacts/cache/* && systemctl restart warmup-agent` on cordoned nodes after we validate.

carol-sre: Observability note: after fallback routing, 5xxs dropped to 1.7% but tail latency elevated for a subset of customers who hit older nodes. Need to ensure fallback TTL is long enough for rollout (~30m).

incident-bot: :hourglass: Handoff: @alice-oncall -> @carol-sre for monitoring and rollout at 03:02Z for 30m.

carol-sre: Taking watch. @bob-runtime please upload artifacts: heapdumps, deserializers traces, and GPU JIT logs for usw2-host-5 and usw2-host-22 to `s3://redwood-debug/incidents/2965432100/`.

bob-runtime: Uploaded: `usw2-host-5.heap`, `usw2-host-22.jit.log`, `deser-usw2-host-5.txt`. Observations: corrupted shard checksums explain footer truncation; JIT logs show repeated recompiles for identical kernels when memory pressure increases.

grace-ml: Suggest long-term changes: 1) pre-validate artifacts via checksum during ingest/upload pipeline 2) maintain per-driver compile time profiles and tune timeouts per GPU driver 3) implement warmup concurrency controller to prevent autoscaler stampedes.

alice-oncall: Who owns the short fixes? @bob-runtime implement runtime hotfix, @frank-infra coordinate canary, @grace-ml run JIT driver benchmarks, @david-support coordinate customer comms.

bob-runtime: Hotfix PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4410 (hotfix/warmup-integrity). Changes: artifact sha256 validation + mirror failover; controlled shard loader (2 at a time); compile_timeout_seconds=120; semaphore to serialize JITs per GPU during warmup; exponential backoff with jitter on retries.

frank-infra: Canary deployed at 03:08Z to us-west-2-canary. Monitoring metrics for 12m.

carol-sre: Canary signals: warmup error rate on canary nodes dropped by 80%, GPU memory fragmentation no longer observed, and no new CrashLoopBackOffs. Proceeding with rolling update to other nodes in AZ-a.

david-support: Notified accounts C-900 and C-921 about fallback and next steps; both requested a post-incident summary.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation actions applied: routing fallback, autoscaler paused, nodes cordoned, hotfix canary + rollouts. Status changed: degraded -> mitigated.

hector-ce: Scheduling customer calls for 03:45Z to discuss incident and provide timeline.

alice-oncall: Closing pager for now. Please collect final artifacts and file RCA: root cause = corrupted artifact shard + aggressive JIT timeouts + warmup concurrency causing resource exhaustion. Remediations: artifact integrity checks in pipeline, adaptive compile timeouts per driver, warmup orchestration throttles, and better fallback routing docs.

carol-sre: Will consolidate timeline and open postmortem doc. Action items assigned: [bob-runtime] merge hotfix & prod rollout verification, [frank-infra] re-enable autoscaler with safe caps, [grace-ml] JIT profiling matrix across drivers, [david-support/hector-ce] customer comms.

alice-oncall: Thanks all. React with :rotating_light: if it spikes again. Pager closed at 03:13Z.
